positions.title: Senior Perception Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed core perception features of a terrain-relative navigation sensor in C++ that uses optical cameras to enable precise localization of spacecraft during lunar landings.
- Designed a flexible testing pipeline for algorithm evaluation in Python to enhance our team’s productivity, resulting in optimizations which reduced the navigation sensor’s pose estimation error by over 60%.
- Wrote technical reports and performed demonstrations of perception technologies for contract stakeholders.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Perception
positions.description:
- Wrote flight software in C++ and implemented a series of software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop tests to ensure its robustness and validate performance requirements.
- Supported flight testing in the field and conducted spacecraft integration activities which required
cross-functional collaboration with systems engineers and the mission operations team.
- Implemented a prototype deep-learning model in PyTorch for spacecraft detection and tracking.

company.name: SHREC: Center for Space, High-Performance, and Resilient Computing

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Led research project on hybrid SoC architectures for autonomous navigation in space
- Mentored several undergraduate students on FPGA-related research projects
- Created and optimized several computer vision CPU/FPGA modules written using C++/VHDL
- Investigated ML-based approaches for visual feature extraction in space environments

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Investigated applications of FPGAs for acceleration of image processing tasks
- Participated in SHREC 2019 Summer Undergraduate Research Group (SURG)

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Graded assignments and held office hours for Analog Circuit Analysis and Design course
- Devised new FPGA-related educational assignments for Advanced Digital Design course

company.name: University of Pittsburgh Swanson School of Engineering

positions.title: R&D Engineering Co-Op
positions.description:
- Conducted firmware, software, and hardware development/testing of embedded
system devices for turbine control
- Developed for CPU/FPGA systems using C and VHDL (respectively)
- Performed design revisions to attain higher safety standard certifications
